about_the_game:
Warfield Heroes Project

Warfield Heroes Project is an independent online multiplayer shooter inspired by the Battlefield Heroes universe. This project is developed in accordance with Electronic Arts' (EA) intellectual property terms of use.

Warfield Heroes Project is not affiliated with or sponsored by Electronic Arts. All original visual assets have been replaced with original creations to comply with EA’s guidelines regarding the use of their intellectual property.

Our goal is to deliver a fun and competitive gameplay experience while fully respecting EA’s rights and rules.

Factions & Classes

Players join one of two iconic factions:

  • Royal Army

  • National Army

You can choose between three distinct classes, each with their own strengths and playstyle:

  • Commando – Stealthy and fast, ideal for long-range eliminations and surprise attacks.

  • Soldier – A balanced all-rounder, effective at medium range with solid offensive abilities.

  • Gunner – A tanky powerhouse built for frontal assaults and suppressive fire.

Available Game Modes

  • TDM (Team Deathmatch) – Two teams face off in fast-paced combat to score the most eliminations. Coordination and skill lead to victory.

  • HOTH (Hold The Hill / Rocket Capture) – A strategic mode where teams must capture and hold a central rocket position to earn points over time. Dominate the objective to win!

More game modes will be added in future updates.

Goals & Progression

The ultimate goal: rise through the ranks and become the best hero of all!
Win battles, climb leaderboards, and show off your customized hero as you improve your skills.

Key Features

  • 🎮 Fast-paced online multiplayer action

  • ⚔️ Three unique hero classes with distinct playstyles

  • 🧠 Arcade-style gameplay that’s easy to learn but offers deep tactical choices

  • 🧍 Full character customization (appearance, outfits, etc.)

  • 🏆 Competitive rankings and player stats tracking

Visual Style & Atmosphere

Featuring cartoon-style graphics, smooth animations, and a lively soundtrack, Warfield Heroes Project captures the spirit of classic lighthearted shooters while delivering modern multiplayer action.

What Makes This Game Unique?

Warfield Heroes Project is a community-driven indie game, created by passionate developers who aim to revive the spirit of fun, accessible, and strategic multiplayer shooters.
Frequent updates will bring new content, modes, and improvements based on community feedback.

Ce projet n’est pas commercial, ni affilié, ni endorsement par Electronic Arts Inc.
Tous les droits sur Battlefield Heroes® appartiennent à Electronic Arts Inc.
Les logos officiels d’EA et de Battlefield Heroes ont été remplacés ou retirés pour se conformer à la politique d’EA, qui interdit l’utilisation des logos ou marques déposées dans des projets non autorisés.

  • Graphics: 64MB DirectX compliant video card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c

  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1050 GTX
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
